name: composer
title: Composer
summary: The box people write to an agent in: a growing text field, attached files and a bar of actions with Send.
use_when: The input at the bottom of a chat or agent workspace
A prompt that can carry files, a model or a context choice
avoid_when: A comment or note without an agent: use Textarea with a Button
A one-line search: use Input Group

props.onSubmit: (message: string) => void, called with the trimmed text on Enter or Send
props.status: idle | running: while running, Send becomes Stop
props.hasAttachments: boolean: lets a message with files but no text send

copy.placeholder: An invitation in a few words: "Ask anything"
copy.actions: Every icon action has an aria-label: "Add files", "Dictate"

a11y: Enter sends and Shift+Enter starts a new line; nothing sends mid-composition in an input method
Send is disabled while the message is empty; Stop replaces it while the reply runs
